title: fix: link staging models to staging OpenWebUI
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Opens staging model test links in the staging OpenWebUI deployment.
- Keeps development and production links on the production deployment.
- Split from #14622.

gist.headline: Staging gets its own door
gist.blurb: Staging models now walk through the staging OpenWebUI door instead of wandering into production. The test garden has the right gate again.
gist.summary: Updated the model test-link component so staging models open the staging OpenWebUI deployment, while development and production models continue opening production OpenWebUI.
gist.impact: People testing staging models now land in the matching staging chat environment, keeping test conversations aligned with the models they selected.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful test gardener using two clearly labeled cozy portal doors: a lime-green STAGING door leading to a small CRT chat terminal in a garden shed, and a production door in the background. Polli should actively guide a tiny model-code seed toward the staging door, showing that each environment now reaches its proper OpenWebUI home.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny tester's clipboard, guiding a glowing code-seed through a lime green (#ecf874) garden gate labeled “STAGING” toward a friendly CRT OpenWebUI terminal; a second production gate sits neatly in the background among flowers and code-plants. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, subtle scanlines, dark purple (#110518) outlines, emotionally warm.
